lines.en: The ground sinks as I walk.
My body drags a layer of dust.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在收拾废墟。
lines.en: Each step is like tidying ruins.

lines.zh: 源石从我脊背里长出来。
lines.en: Originium grows from my spine.
I cross this waste slowly.
My feet crush old bones.
My tread is heavy, a sound a league.
I am looking for ore that remains.
My shadow lies very low.
I step over a fallen wall.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，尘还在落。
lines.en: Where I have walked, the dust still falls.

lines.zh: 我转了一下头，颈椎在响。
lines.en: I turn my head and my neck grinds.
I stand like a broken wall.
Dust gathers on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我在听这片地还剩下什么。
lines.en: I listen to what is left in this land.
I slowly straighten myself.
The ore inside me rings softly.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，就已经很重。
lines.en: Even idle, I am heavy.
My palm lies open.

lines.zh: 这里曾经有过很多东西。
lines.en: There used to be many things here.
I count the distant pillars.
I lower my head to my feet.
You are still whole.

lines.zh: 我看你，就像看从前的样子。
lines.en: I look at you and see how things were.
You carry no dust; very new.
Every part of me is old.

lines.zh: 你不该在这片荒原上走。
lines.en: You should not walk this waste.
I raise a hand, taller than you.

lines.zh: 你的心跳我隔着尘听见。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through the dust.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到了活气。
lines.en: I smell life on you.
Only I and the rubble are left here.
Will you stay?
You cut through one shell of mine.
Fragments fall off me.
The gash you cut is glowing.
The pain makes my ore ring.
This wreckage does not fear pain.
A good blow, cut deep.
I slowly lift my arm back.

lines.zh: 一条裂缝从我肩通到腰。
lines.en: A crack runs from shoulder to waist.
I have not fallen yet.
You have a few more in you.
I want that pure ore.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，骨架一节节响。
lines.en: I bend, and my frame grinds joint by joint.
I can see it clearly while you hold it.

lines.zh: 把矿放下，人退到三步外。
lines.en: Set the ore down and stand three paces off.
My fingers are too thick to catch it.

lines.zh: 这点量，只够我修一块甲。
lines.en: Enough to mend one plate.

lines.zh: 我掰开胸甲，把它填进去。
lines.en: I pry open my chest plate and pack it in.
Do you have more?
I chew slowly; it is heavy.
The taste is old, and strong.
You charge in; it is your shoulder that breaks.
I do not move; you fall back.
The bump raises a cloud of dust.
Your shoulder cracks against me.
I put up a hand to stop you.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，地面都陷了。
lines.en: The ground sank where we met.
I am far heavier than you.

lines.zh: 别靠着我，我身上全是刺。
lines.en: Don't lean on me; I am all spikes.
You fell back; I did not press.
Dust settles between us.
Only wreckage remains of this body.
I am the part that was left behind.

lines.zh: 荒原上不会有第二个我。
lines.en: There will be no second me on this waste.
You ask too far ahead.
I lower my head and do not answer.
Ore grows; other things do not.
I want only the ore that remains.
That subject is too light for me.
I turn and the dust rises again.
Leave it to the living.
I bend and push the rubble aside.

lines.zh: 我把它捏在两根手指间。
lines.en: I hold it between two fingers.
It is too small in my palm.

lines.zh: 我把它按进肩上的裂口。
lines.en: I press it into the crack in my shoulder.
This piece has gone dark.
I rub it between two fingers and it becomes powder.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前，看了很久。
lines.en: I hold it up to my eyes and look a long while.
I toss it into the pit behind me.
I keep one piece in my sleeve.
Hold it; don't drop it.

lines.zh: 你在这片空地上很显眼。
lines.en: You stand out in this open waste.
Only you still move in these ruins.

lines.zh: 我开始一步一步碾过来。
lines.en: I begin grinding forward, step by step.
The dust rises with me.
You crushed the ore beneath my feet.
I do not shout; I simply keep walking.

lines.zh: 你身后那道墙，我一步就过。
lines.en: That wall behind you — one stride and I am through.
You are worth twenty-five points.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿提到了半空。
lines.en: I raise one leg into the air.
How much farther can you retreat?
I have been waiting for you to step in.
Nothing living here except you.
I lower my head to your feet.
I mean to clear this ground.
Run; I can wait.
After this step, near enough.
No hurry; I grind forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 你跑过断墙，我直接跨过。
lines.en: You run past a wall; I step over it.
My feet are loud on the rubble.
You hesitated at the pit's edge.
Cracks follow me along the ground.
I stop and let the dust settle.
You hide behind a pillar.
I push the pillar over.
I raise my hand slowly.
You have only one way.

lines.zh: 我量着你两步之间的空当。
lines.en: I measure the gap between your steps.
You are running uphill.
I wait at the bottom, unhurried.
The ore grows louder.

lines.zh: 你回头，我正碾碎一块碑。
lines.en: You look back as I crush a gravestone.
Four steps left, and my shoulder is already lowered.
Back further and you meet the ore wall.
The ground is starting to give.
Now only distance remains.

lines.zh: 我站到你面前，尘落下来。
lines.en: I stand before you as the dust settles.

lines.zh: 我一掌落下，石头飞起来。
lines.en: My palm falls, and stone flies up.

lines.zh: 我把你扫出去，撞塌半堵墙。
lines.en: I sweep you away into a half-fallen wall.
I draw a crystal spike from my shoulder.
You blocked, and the shield caved.

lines.zh: 我的指头扣住你的胳膊。
lines.en: My fingers close around your arm.

lines.zh: 你砍进我的腿，我退了半步。
lines.en: You cut into my leg and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我一手把你按进碎石堆。
lines.en: I press you into the rubble with one hand.
Dust covers us both.

lines.zh: 你又砍了一下，我这次没躲。
lines.en: You struck again; I did not dodge.
I lift a foot, and my shadow covers you first.
You roll clear, raising only dust.
I turn my whole bulk toward you.
That was heavy enough, wasn't it.
You are on the ground and I am beside you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，把你提起来。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder and lift you.
Good; let it end here.
I drive my elbow onto the shield.
The shock numbs your arms.

lines.zh: 你的手腕在我指间太小。
lines.en: Your wrist is tiny between my fingers.
Dust settles over us both.

lines.zh: 我从倒塌的矿层里站起。
lines.en: I rise from the collapsed seam.
The dust parts first; then I am there.
This body holds six hundred.
At last there is movement on the waste.
My spine straightens inch by inch.

lines.zh: 源石在我体内重新排布。
lines.en: The originium settles inside me.
Several broken pillars stand far off.
The light on my back is cold.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，试试力气。
lines.en: I raise a hand to test my strength.
This land is mine to clear.
I turn toward the fire.
I take my first step, slowly.
Fire burns inside my cracks; it is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我砸进地里，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I crash into the earth and leave a crater.
Water fills my chest and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸崩掉了我大半个肩。
lines.en: The blast tears off much of my shoulder.
An arrow lodges in my seam.

lines.zh: 术力撞在我空掉的胸腔里。
lines.en: The spell rattles in my hollow chest.
The ore is gone and I begin to dry.
Lightning runs down my spine.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，尘在身后散开。
lines.en: I fall, dust scattering behind me.
